item.title: New Home Construction Slows in 2025, But Still Posts Third Best Year on Record in Walker County
item.description: New home construction in unincorporated Walker County slowed last year, as the cost of construction drove new home prices higher. Still, 2025 ranked as the third best year on record for the county, despite an 11% decline from the previous year.
